title: feat(my-models): link each card to earnings activity
author: TRDEFI
pr_body_excerpt:
﻿Closes #13894

Each My Models card now has a small "View activity" link that opens the existing Activity page filtered to that model.

- Uses the dashboard's existing `earningsModels` search state (`/activity?earningsModels=<modelId>`), so reloading or sharing the URL keeps the selection.
- No new API, charts, or duplicated earnings UI — just the current routing.

gist.headline: Follow the pollen trail
gist.blurb: My Models cards now include a small View activity link. One click takes you straight to that model's earnings trail, because making people reconstruct a URL by hand is not a feature.
gist.summary: Added a "View activity" link to every My Models card that opens the existing Activity dashboard filtered via `/activity?earningsModels=<modelId>`.
gist.impact: Model creators can jump directly from a model card to its earnings activity, and the selected model remains intact when the URL is reloaded or shared.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny accountant visor and carrying a clipboard, follows a glowing lime-green pollen trail from a row of model cards to a cozy retro Activity terminal. The terminal displays a simple earnings graph for one selected flower-like code model, with small flowers and code-plants showing that each model has its own traceable activity.
